scores.evidence: Tokens, 56/48/44 hit tiers, 8/12/16 radii, Space Grotesk + IBM Plex Mono, cyan only on band/logo/nav marker/tour ring, one action-blue button per view, no dark shadows all hold (screens/today-dark-1440.png, inventory.json: nav rows 48, primary 56, radius 8). Misses: tile heights are 162 vs 179 instead of one size (today-dark-1440.png rows 1 vs 3); body-map 'Trend' and 'Open alerts for actions' buttons render about 36px tall, but brief 4 limits 36px to ground tables (body-dark-1440.png); 'simulated reading' chips on every check-in field are not in the brief; Routine patch emblems are not the 1px line-icon set the brief requires.

Today is a true 1-2-3: 56px 'Act now' word + reason, one 56px blue 'Start check-in', body map; fold at 1440x900 and 390x844 shows all three (desktop-fold.png, mobile-fold.png). Defects: below the fold 15 equal tiles, each with a baseline band and a 14-bar strip, flatten the answer (three Act now tiles look like the nine Nominal ones except for a small pill); the last row is an orphan of 3 in a 4-column grid; Routine leaves a dead band under the Today list while the right column runs 1,000px longer (routine-dark-1440.png); Alerts ends in a second app of 5 stacked comm panels (alerts-dark-1440.png); Ground view opens with three near-empty full-width panels before the crew grid (ground-dark-1440.png); Review step 'Symptoms and notes' panel stretches to match Sleep with one line inside (flow-review-1440.png).

Two families, weights 400/500/600, status word 56px/-0.03em, sentence case, tabular mono for every number, left-aligned paragraphs (today-dark-1440.png, trends-dark-1440.png). Defects: operational text is set at 13px muted (reference ranges under every check-in field, the 'flight surgeon should hear about this' line, tile labels, the 'about 2 min / Step 1 of 5' budget) on a crew tablet; Streak panel on Routine sets a 28px '0' beside a floating sentence that starts with 'days' so the number and its label do not read as one unit (routine-dark-1440.png).

4px scale and 24px panel gaps are consistent. Defects: equal things not equal, tiles 162 vs 179px because two-line labels wrap ('Blood pressure, systolic', 'Sleepiness (Karolinska scale)') in today-dark-1440.png; check-in footer hint 'Enter for next, Shift+Enter for back' floats mid-footer, aligned to neither Back nor Next (checkin-step1-dark-1440.png); on 390 the Next button sits 12px inside the Confirm-all button's left edge (checkin-step1-dark-390.png, x 45 vs 33); Review step Symptoms panel stretch; Routine dead column.

Named palette (cool graphite ramp, cyan brand, one action blue, status hues for meaning) is coherent and cyan/blue never swap roles; dark depth by surface steps and 1px hairlines, light by soft panel shadow (today-dark-1440.png, today-light-1440.png). Defects: 15 tiles x 14 saturated bars paint a large block of full-strength green that competes with the single red 'Act now' word, so the one important colour moment is diluted; day-strip bars carry status by colour alone (brief 2 says word + shape + colour); the Act now word is the only strong moment on the screen and the rest is evenly mid-contrast.

Family is cohesive (components-button.png: 48px nav and crew chips, 56px primary, radius 8 everywhere; seven brief components ported and restyled: tour, wizard rail, number field, segmented thumb, day strip, digits, timeline). CSS shows hover, :active translateY(1px), disabled 40% and focus-visible 2px ring (styles.css:97,142-165). Defects: native selects (crew, link, indicator, crew member) show the OS chevron and a different border treatment from the segmented control; checkbox on Trends/Ground/Routine is a default-looking 24px box; textareas show the native resize handle (ground-dark-1440.png); mission-patch emblems mix a digit, a check mark, two letters and a glyph (routine-dark-1440.png); 'Open' appears on 5 of 8 routine rows with no rule; tile height outlier. Hover/pressed/loading renders were not captured, so they are read from CSS only.

No gradients, glows, emoji, uppercase tracked labels, loops, custom cursors or hype copy (clean.md audit confirmed on rendered screens); copy is plain and sourced. Defects: placeholder-looking patch emblems on Routine; three empty 'No messages / Nothing delivered yet' panels on Ground and Alerts read as unfinished scaffolding rather than designed empty states; the same finding card is repeated four times (Alerts, Body map, Ground, Review) at near-identical weight.

Motion system exists per verify.md/clean.md: ring sweep 700ms on save, direction-aware step slide with filling rail, tutorial glide 480ms, digit-by-digit readouts, one easing; numbers pass: p95 8.5ms, 0 dropped, 0 long tasks, CLS 0.0062 (smoothness.json). Reduced-motion fallback is documented and a reduced desktop capture exists. Not scored higher because I could only see static frames: sweep, slide and glide playback, and hover/press timing are unverified; the reduced-motion render was not individually inspected.

390 is composed, bottom bar with 5 items and 56px targets, no overflow at 390/867/1440 (verify.md), How-to-measure disclosure replaces the cue card (checkin-step1-dark-390.png). Defects: Today at 390 is about 1,900px tall because all 15 tiles stack 2-up; on mobile the status pill drops under the label so the tile becomes a different component (today-dark-390.png); step rail loses its step names; Next button inset mismatch.

scores.category: Memorability (functional: onboarding, empty states, data moments, signature detail)
scores.evidence: Strengths: a real 7-step spotlight tutorial on actual UI (tour-desktop-4.png ringing a live baseline band, tour-mobile-3.png ringing the Check-in nav item, mobile-fold.png), keyboard operable and replayable; a signature detail (cyan baseline band, live in check-in fields, trends and tiles) found nowhere else; tell-someone sentence names an experience; differs from KRAG One and the newsprint paper on theme, palette and type. Gaps: the tutorial does not show where to put values field by field (the cue card does, but only after Start check-in); the status ring is a plain stroked arc with no instrument character (no ticks, no segment per indicator even though the centre says 9/15); empty states have no designed moment; the look is a well-built dark dashboard but a squinting viewer could mistake it for a generic admin template apart from the cyan bands.

Contrast rendered check passes on all views both themes (verify.md); focus ring 2px action with offset; primary flow 6 keyboard actions at 3 widths; labels on inputs; one h1 plus noscript h1. Defects: 36px controls below the 48px crew floor (body-map 'Trend' buttons, 'Open alerts for actions') on a glove-friendly tablet; day-strip bars are colour-only; 13px muted text for medical reference ranges on a crew tablet; dark text-muted on surface-3 is 4.12:1 (not rendered today, but a latent failure); routine checkboxes visible at about 24px with the row as the target is not obvious.

uxWeighting: Product goal 'easy and quick for astronauts' is mostly met: one answer on Today, one next-action, a prefilled five-step check-in saved in 6 keyboard actions, a first-run tutorial with 7 spotlights, cue cards that say how to measure on board and why it matters in space. What holds it below 90 is density and consistency, not the core flow: Today asks the crew to scan 15 equal tiles, Alerts and Ground view add long comm panels, and several sibling elements differ in size.

fixes.now: 15 equal tiles in a 4-col grid, orphan last row, heights 162 vs 179
fixes.target: Split the grid into 'Needs attention' (every Watch and Act now tile, first, tile fill --surface-2, status pill leading) and 'In range' (Nominal tiles, same 162px height, day strip hidden until tile focus/hover on desktop and shown on tap). Give every tile `min-height: 162px` and shorten the two-line labels via a `shortLabel` in indicators.ts (e.g. 'Systolic BP', 'Diastolic BP', 'Sleepiness (KSS)', 'Reaction time, mean', 'Reaction lapses') so labels stay on one line at 13px. Result: the three Act now tiles stand out, mobile Today shrinks, tiles equal.
fixes.why: Hick and Von Restorff; fixes hierarchy, spacing, responsive and equal-things-equal in one move.
